record.question: What exact segment traversal connects each remaining published Lassen trailhead and destination, including shared junctions and alternatives?
record.reason: Wayproof publishes complete, bidirectional, distance-bearing trailhead-to-summit graphs for Lassen Peak and Brokeoff Mountain and a connected distance-bearing parking-to-basin-entry graph for Bumpass Hell. It also publishes ordered, bidirectional Warner Valley topology for Devils Kitchen and Terminal Geyser, but atomic leg distances remain unknown where route descriptions print only cumulative positions. Cinder Cone, Boiling Springs Lake, the full Bumpass basin circulation, the Kings Creek alternative, and shared Warner Valley corridors still require route-specific reconciliation before being described as complete visitor traversals.
